# Test Fixtures

- `info.plist` and `prefs.plist` are adapted from the upstream Dart
  `alfred_workflow` 1.2.4 test fixtures.
- `script_filter_full.json` and `script_filter_exact_order.json` are canonical
  Script Filter JSON regression snapshots. Update them only when the supported
  wire contract intentionally changes.
- `github_release.json` is a deterministic GitHub release payload for updater
  model and asset-selection coverage.
